data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 5.7m (2021: GBP 120.9m) is a favourable development of GBP 20.5m (2021: deterioration of GBP 0.8m pre LPT) to claims reserves established at the prior year end.

prior_year_events.event_name: Loss Portfolio Transfer Reinsurance (LPT) with RiverStone
prior_year_events.impact_description: CMA entered into an LPT with RiverStone in December 2021 covering the majority of classes no longer written by Syndicates 4444 (2020 & prior years) and 1861 (2020 year only); premium ceded under the contract and reinsurers' share of change in provisions includes recoveries on the business reinsured under the agreement.

prior_year_events.event_name: Part VII transfer to Lloyd's Brussels (and related 100% quota share reinsurance back)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Policies underwritten in the EEA for years of account between 1993 and April 2019 (and Oct 2020 for German reinsurance) were transferred to Lloyd's Brussels on 30 Dec 2020 and reinsured back under a 100% quota share; cash of $63.7m was transferred and reinsured back, with no economic impact on the Syndicate.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2022 gross claims outstanding were GBP 391.956m. Analysis of the gross claims development table shows a net gross strengthening of approximately GBP 7.156m in prior year estimates (adverse movement driven by the 2020 underwriting year more than offsetting favourable development on 2019). Management commentary highlights a favourable net development of GBP 20.5m at the net level, and notes the impact of a December 2021 Loss Portfolio Transfer (RiverStone) and the earlier Part VII/ quota share arrangements which affect recoveries and reported balances. No specific catastrophe events are named as drivers of the gross reserve movement.
raw_causal_phrases: positive claims development during the year
the reinsurers' share of the change in provisions for claims includes the recoveries due on the business reinsured under the agreement
Loss Portfolio Transfer Reinsurance (LPT) agreement with RiverStone
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development was derived from the gross claims development triangle (gross figures) because the only explicit narrative movement statement in the notes referenced NET development. There is inconsistency between the net favourable movement (GBP 20.5m) quoted in the narrative and the gross triangle-derived net strengthening (+GBP 7.156m). The syndicate completed a Loss Portfolio Transfer (Dec 2021) and there are Part VII / quota-share arrangements which can distort both gross and net movements and recoveries; no line-by-line LOB reserve movements are provided.
